scripts.turbo:build: tauri build --bundles app && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R "src/target/release/bundle/macos/Content Relay.app" dist/
scripts.turbo:lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path src/Cargo.toml --check && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=src/target/lint cargo clippy --manifest-path src/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
